name: 夕阳再现-疯狂江湖
english_description: The site's subtitle is "Crazy Jianghu." It belongs to the Sunset Reappears family of wuxia MUD engines, sharing common roots with this project's xyzxfy2 (Storm Rises Again II), wmkj, jhfy, and bixiecanyang — each an independent game world built by a different site on the same base engine. This branch carries the genuine Sunset Reappears map lineage (byte-identical to xyzx, jhfy3, xajh4gkb, and xyzxyl201412), unlike another cluster of archives in this collection that share the same branding but actually run on an unrelated "Tianya" map family.
